dataset_limits: Historical self-selected app reviews are not the complete customer population.

Cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn.

I_USABILITY.evidence_quote: I've loved Spotify but it's baffling to me how every update they make seems to make the app LESS user friendly. When they removed the daily mixes from the home page, that was a swing and miss. When they first reworked the home page to have a bunch of unnecessary recommendations instead of access to recently played options (which they later reverted) that was a fail. And now they've removed the ability to move episode to episode on podcasts from the toolbar in exchange for playback speed? WHY??
some features are missing in updated version

For free subscription I find this to be a cancerous and even dangerous app while driving. Will try to make your life difficult finding your songs, esp. while on the go, e.g. will not let you go to any random song in a playlist while on mobile, except for the first few uses. For the paid plan, no such ugly surprises, just still not as easy to find your stuff as it should be.

I_ACCESS.description: Reviews report repeated login failures, incorrect connection or number errors, and accounts being logged out unexpectedly.

I_BILLING.description: Reviews describe dissatisfaction with premium pricing and ads, or difficulty subscribing and accessing paid features after payment.

I_CATALOG.description: Reviews mention missing songs or lyrics, repetitive recommendations, and unavailable podcasts.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Reviews report downloads getting stuck, disappearing, or failing to play offline, including after storage changes.

I_OTHER.description: Reviews express general dissatisfaction or describe the app as empty or recent updates as poor, without identifying a more specific issue.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Reviews report playback stopping, failing to start, showing a black screen, or playing a different song than the one selected.

I_USABILITY.description: Reviews describe confusing navigation and removed or restricted controls, including difficulty finding content and managing playback.
